positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Utilizing Gephi in visualizing connectivity in YouTube user Data
• Utilized Microsoft PowerBI and Python for sentiment analysis on Canada Election Data

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implementing Java, MySql, HTML/CSS, JavaScript and Elasticsearch into backend web application development
● Developing web applications and API development using python’s Flask web framework and Jersey
● Creating ETL pipelines for web crawling and reverse engineering APIs using SCRAPY framework on PYTHON and MySQL
● Utilizing the ELK stack for parsing and visualizing log files using Filebeat, data ingestion using Logstash, etc
● Optimizing SQL database design and queries for Blogtrackers with Implementation of multithreading and multiprocessing pools on
Blogtrackers Application (Pathos, java.util.concurrent.*, etc)
● Developing d3.js visualizations for reporting purposes on web application in a scrum agile software development team
● Utilizing a distributed data processing system (SPARK), peer to peer code review, managing IT infrastructure and development

positions.title: Project Management and Process Development Intern - Data Science
positions.description:
● Utilized Power Bi in creating dashboards to track success migration metrics
● Created an automated workflow for text mapping/cross referencing for data migration
● Created an automated workflow for tracking and updating projects from Azure DevOps to Windstream portal using Python
● Utilized Oracle SQL and Microsoft SQL Server on an ETL platform for data migration from legacy systems to new Windstream systems

positions.title: Data QC Engineer
positions.description:
• QA, QC of seismic data tape copy and integrity check from log files for report Generation using Excel VBA and PYTHON.  
• Well logs inventory QC using PYTHON libraries. 
• Project tracker and data mining using PYTHON and PowerBI.  
• Ovation Data DPTS-MTC4 for seismic data tape copy, SEGYCHECK for seismic data integrity check, etc.  
• Data wrangling with the use of PYTHON, Excel VBA and EXCEL Spreadsheet.  
• Object Oriented Programming for project management applications with PHP.
